title: Buttons — every style the app uses today

steps.path: The top-right corner of Sound, Tags & note, Games and a Marketplace item's Details
steps.headline: Popups close three different ways. Which should every popup and side panel use?
steps.notice: You already picked the shared popup title for every popup; this decides its close control. Esc closes every popup whichever you pick.
steps.risk: Plain text takes more room in the title line than an ✕, so long titles would shorten sooner.

variants.label: ✕ button
variants.summary: Sound (and most popups). A drawn ✕ with a soft hover square.

variants.label: ✕, Tags & note
variants.summary: Tags & note. The same ✕, moved over by the last session.

variants.label: Small × letter
variants.summary: Games. A typed × character, smaller and fainter than the ✕.

variants.label: Esc · Close text
variants.summary: Marketplace Details and the file viewer. Words instead of a symbol, matching Esc · Back to chat on full screens.

steps.path: Main buttons in popups, setup and Projects
steps.headline: Buttons come in two shapes: rounded rectangles and fully rounded pills. Where should pills be used?
steps.notice: Almost every button is a rounded rectangle. Pills appear in first-run setup and on Tags & note's Done. The last line of each summary says what changes if that picture becomes the standard.

variants.label: Rectangles, full width
variants.summary: Themes popup. A plain outlined button and a filled one, both full width with gently rounded corners.

variants.label: Rectangle, large
variants.summary: Projects. The large filled New Conversation button — the same shape, bigger.

variants.label: Pill, full width
variants.summary: Tags & note. The only full-width pill outside setup. Picking rectangles would make it match Themes.

variants.label: Pills in setup
variants.summary: First-run sign-in. Five stacked pills; today's rule allows pills only here.

steps.path: Controls that switch between views or filters
steps.headline: "Pick one" controls come in three looks. Which should switch views and filters everywhere?
steps.notice: Tabs and filter strips are pills with a filled choice; Sound uses a boxed two-part switch; Project Files switches grid and list with two bare icons. Pick more than one if different jobs deserve different looks.

variants.label: Pill tabs
variants.summary: Projects: Files 17 · Conversations 2 · Instructions & Memories 3. A rounded strip with the chosen one filled.

variants.label: Pill filters
variants.summary: Marketplace: All · Plugins · Skills… The same pill strip used for filtering.

variants.label: Boxed switch
variants.summary: Sound: Needs Attention / Response Ready. A full-width box split in two, the chosen half filled.

variants.label: Bare icons
variants.summary: Project Files: grid and list icons on the right, with only a faint square on the chosen one.

steps.surface: Chat cards, popups and full screens
steps.path: The less important button beside a main one
steps.headline: Secondary buttons come in five styles. Which should a less important action use?
steps.notice: Examples: Preview beside Resume, Cancel beside Create, Your Library beside Back to chat. Pick one if a single style should do this job everywhere.

variants.label: Outlined, small
variants.summary: Chat cards: Preview beside a filled Resume.

variants.label: Outlined, header
variants.summary: Marketplace: Your Library, an outlined button beside the way back to chat.

variants.label: Filled grey
variants.summary: Your Library: Marketplace, the same job as the left picture but a filled grey button.

variants.label: Text only
variants.summary: Add a project: Cancel is plain text with no box at all.

variants.label: Outlined, full width
variants.summary: Themes: Browse Theme Marketplace, outlined and full width above the filled main button.
